prior_gaps.description: No fresh estimate was run. estimateParams.m calls parcluster and parpool (lines 31-33), patternsearch (lines 223-225), and cdf("chi2", ...) (line 236); the latest saved MATLAB metadata lists only MATLAB and MATLAB Copilot, with required toolbox functions unavailable. The estimator also calls momentsSim.m, whose line 57 assigns through the misspelled nmnaip_temp while lines 58-61 use nmanip_temp. The one-line correction remains proposed but unapplied pending source review. These environment and source prerequisites block a fresh SMM result.

invertPrice.m requires gmmobjres from the estimator. The estimator was not run, so no new inversion CSV was produced. The packaged manipulation CSV was used only as the authored R table branch input and cannot count as a new invertPrice result.

The approved R stage faithfully captured both source-formatted TeX tables, but did not create note_on_estimates.pdf. The saved deps_01 metadata records rmarkdown as missing and the saved PATH inventory records pandoc unavailable; package installation was not authorized.
